question.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(0.25),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(0.75)^{x-1}(0.25), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3\le X<7) & =P(X\in \{3,4,5,6\}) \\  & =P(X=3)+P(X=4)+P(X=5)+P(X=6) \\  & =f(3)+f(4)+f(5)+f(6) \\  & =(0.75)^{2}(0.25)+(0.75)^{3}(0.25)+(0.75)^{4}(0.25)+(0.75)^{5}(0.25) \\  & ≈0.3845.\end{aligned}
$$
